title: USC scientists discover how to create a never-ending supply of cancer-fighting cells
caption:
Biologists have uncovered a technique to expand immune progenitor cells in the lab so they can continually produce tumor-hunting macrophages inside bone marrow. The strategy proved effective in mouse models of solid and blood cancers.

Source: Sciencedaily - USC scientists discover how to create a never-ending supply of cancer-fighting cells
